senses.gloss: (v. גפף) to make thick, tighten. Denom. גָּפְרִית; fr. which

units: <cite ref="Bava Batra 97b">B. Bath. 97ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Tosefta Bava Batra 6:3">Tosef. ib. VI, 3</cite> <he>מְגוּפָּרוֹת</he> (defective clay vessels) made tight by a lining of sulphur or pitch.

<cite ref="Shabbat 18a:5">Sabb. 18ᵃ</cite>; Y. ib. I, 4ᵃ top; <cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 1:23">Tosef. ib. I, 23</cite> <he>מִתְגַּפְּרִין</he> they (the silver vessels) go through the process of sulphuring.
